UnitStatement: test_api_boundary_contract.py provides stdlib checks for the public API boundary contract (api/api_boundary_contract.yaml).
API boundary contract requires metadata deliverable_id=DEL-10-01, package_id=PKG-10, scope_item=SOW-030, objective=OBJ-009, scope_change_authority=SCA-004.
Public transport protocol, endpoint syntax, OpenAPI transport binding, plugin runtime, signing/isolation, permission grant persistence, and code generation tooling are all metadata-marked TBD.
API boundary contract schema basis is JSON Schema 2020-12.
Persistence boundary must not expose SQL, raw SQLite handles, table names, or direct store mutation; API exposes only application-service commands, queries, or jobs.

Required operation categories include command, query, job, result_envelope, plugin_manifest, diagnostic, provenance, permission, privacy, checksum, export_profile, stable_id_map, loss_report, external_run_evidence, adapter_sdk, validation_test, no_bypass.

Required boundary areas include model_import, model_export, solver_invocation, results, rule_pack_hooks, plugin_manifest, permissions, diagnostics, provenance, privacy, checksums, and SCA-004 export surfaces.
Required commands include ops.model.import/export, ops.solve.start, ops.rule_pack.attach, ops.export.profile/id_map/loss_report, ops.external_run.record, ops.adapter_sdk.register.
Required queries include ops.model.describe, ops.results.get, ops.diagnostics.list, ops.plugin.permissions.describe, and export profile/id_map/loss_report/adapter_sdk describe queries.
Required jobs include ops.solve.job, ops.export.job, ops.report.job, ops.validation.job, and stress_neutral/pcf/review_geometry export jobs.

Required permission tokens include read/write export_profile, read/write stable_id_map, read/write loss_report, record_external_run_evidence, use_adapter_sdk, and export_stress_neutral/conservative_pcf/review_geometry.

No-bypass constraints require domain/unit validation, provenance and privacy preservation, result envelope return, persistence routed through application services, and prohibit exposing SQL/table names or direct project-store mutation.
Forbidden status terms (CODE_COMPLIANT, CERTIFIED, SEALED, APPROVED_FOR_PROFESSIONAL_RELIANCE) must not appear in the contract or plugin boundary doc.
operation.transport is const TBD in the API boundary contract.
result_envelope analysis_status includes HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED but excludes HUMAN_APPROVED_FOR_PROJECT and CODE_COMPLIANT.
human_acceptance_record_ref.software_generated is const False.
privacy_context.telemetry_allowed is const False and classification enum includes protected_suspected.
permission_request.denied_by_default is const True and grant_state enum begins with TBD.

checksum_set canonicalization enum includes JCS-compatible-json; required checksum kinds include export_profile, stable_id_map, loss_report, external_run_evidence, review_geometry_asset, adapter_sdk_manifest.
test_caepipe_external_run_package.py provides focused tests for DEL-17-05 CAEPIPE external-run evidence packages.
A skipped CAEPIPE package without an executable is deterministic, non-blocking, with attempted=False, configured_path_state=absent, all sha256 checksums, and software_bundles_caepipe=False.
A parser-only CAEPIPE package binds CSV rows to sidecar stable IDs (row_count 3, correlation_status canonical_id_map) without blocking diagnostics or compatibility/reliance claims.
Parser records unknown sections and unmapped rows as warnings (CAEPIPE-CSV-UNKNOWN-SECTION, CAEPIPE-CSV-UNMAPPED-ROW) with parser_status parsed_with_diagnostics.
Privacy and authority boundary violations are blocking diagnostics (CAEPIPE-RUN-PRIVACY-BOUNDARY-VIOLATION, CAEPIPE-RUN-AUTHORITY-TERM).
An attempted external CAEPIPE run requires DEL-17-04 binding and user license/environment acknowledgement, else emits MBF-REF-UNSAFE and responsibility-missing diagnostics.
The CAEPIPE writer outputs run_metadata.json plus parsed_csv, diagnostics, and checksums sidecars, excluding parsed_csv from run_metadata.
CAEPIPE external-run fixtures must contain no private or protected payload text (forbidden: real client, asme table, b31j, certified, code compliant, professional acceptance).
test_caepipe_mbf_export_package.py provides focused tests for DEL-17-04 CAEPIPE MBF export packages.
CAEPIPE MBF expected loss categories are exported, omitted, approximated, delegated, unsupported, tbd.
CAEPIPE MBF expected source-basis refs are Deliverables DEL-17-01 and DEL-17-02 plus SourceIDs CAEPIPE-IMPORT-MBF and CAEPIPE-EXPORT-MBF.
The MBF builder is deterministic, with deliverable_id DEL-17-04, package_id PKG-17, target_family caepipe_mbf, sidecar stable-id carrier mode, and carried TBD refs TBD-17-01-001/002/003.
Rendered MBF text is stable and ASCII-safe, with NODE/PIPE records and a 'Canonical IDs are preserved in sidecar mapping' note.
Missing smoke-subset stable IDs and empty loss report are blocking (MBF-SMOKE-SUBSET-MISSING, MBF-STABLE-ID-SIDECAR-MISSING; validation_status blocked).
Unsupported entities require a reference shape (MBF-UNSUPPORTED-ENTITY-REF-MISSING) and a matching loss report entry (MBF-UNSUPPORTED-ENTITY-LOSS-MISSING).
An unsupported entity classified with info-severity loss is unsafe and blocking (MBF-UNSUPPORTED-LOSS-SEVERITY-UNSAFE).
target_version_basis and record_subset_basis must remain carried TBD values, else MBF-TARGET-VERSION-BASIS-UNSAFE / MBF-RECORD-SUBSET-BASIS-UNSAFE block the package.
Required profile TBD refs and source-basis refs must be carried (MBF-CARRIED-TBD-REFS-MISSING, MBF-SOURCE-BASIS-REFS-MISSING).
DEL-17-03 is not a valid CAEPIPE source-basis authority (MBF-SOURCE-BASIS-REFS-UNSAFE).
Privacy and prohibited authority-term violations block a public MBF package (MBF-PROHIBITED-AUTHORITY-TERM, MBF-PRIVACY-BOUNDARY-VIOLATION).
The MBF writer outputs all manifest members with matching declared checksums, using normalized_ascii_lf_text for text members and JCS_compatible_json_payload_hash for JSON members.
test_calculation_witness.py provides formal calculation witness checks for TP-WITNESS-023.
The TP-PHYS-015 section-property-stress witness validates and compares 6 formulas to the result export (bending_normal_stress_z passes).
Generated witness Markdown/MathML must be current and include the witness SHA-256 over canonical JSON and a non-authoritative-source notice.
Witness validation rejects unsupported OpenMath symbols.
Witness validation rejects expected-dimension mismatch.
Witness validation rejects stale generated Markdown.
Witness validation rejects tampered formula output and OPS result mismatch.
Witness validation rejects missing provenance via witness schema validation failure.
Rendered witness Markdown changes when the witness content changes.
test_comparison_contracts.py provides stdlib checks for DEL-14-05 comparison mapping and tolerance schemas.
Comparison schemas pin deliverable_id DEL-14-05, package_id PKG-14, scope_item SOW-073, objective OBJ-016, draft 2020-12, additionalProperties False, and no default keyword.
ProfessionalBoundary requires human_review_required True and all software compliance/certification/sealing/approval/authentication claims False.
Comparison mapping contract binds model_state, analysis_run, result_envelope, and tolerance_profile schemas; comparison engine and report rendering are not implemented by the contract.
MappingStatus enum includes automatic_match, manual_match, unresolved_mapping, unmatched_left, unmatched_right, ignored, TBD.
UnmatchedClassification enum includes left_only, right_only, missing_counterpart, intentionally_ignored, not_comparable, scope_excluded, unresolved_TBD.
ExportContract and JsonExportContract require diagnostics, provenance, assumptions, hash refs, and professional-boundary notice all const True.

CSV export contract enumerates required columns including review_row_id, comparison_id, mapping_id, mapping_status, unit, dimension, tolerance_profile_ref, hash_refs, provenance_ref, professional_boundary_notice.
Tolerance contract is schema-first unit-aware tolerance profiles; default numeric tolerances are not_defined and the result-delta engine is not implemented by the contract.
ToleranceRule requires rule_id, result_family, dimension_id, unit_ref, quantity_kind, tolerance_value(+status), normalization_basis, unit_metadata_policy, hash_refs, review, provenance.
A numeric tolerance_value guard requires tolerance_value_status be externally_governed or project_specific_review_required.
UnitMetadataPolicy requires dimension_id, unit_ref, and normalized-delta unit metadata, with missing unit metadata producing a blocking diagnostic.
Comparison schemas avoid prohibited scope text (formal acceptance, code compliant, certified/sealed by software) and any default keyword.
test_component_section_schema.py provides stdlib checks for the section and component library schemas.
Retired dimensions (temperature_difference, area_moment, stiffness, reference) must not appear in section/component dimensions.
Provenance requires source_name, source_location, source_license, contributor, contributor_certification, redistribution_status, review_status.
Section/component schemas must not contain forbidden public-data text (ASME, B31, CODE_COMPLIANT, certified component/section, automatic compliance, professional approval by the software).

Section schema requires section_library, section_records, dimension/property definitions, completeness_rules, diagnostics, open_decisions; SectionRecord requires privacy_class, redistribution_status, dimensions, properties, completeness, provenance.
SectionPropertyKind enum includes cross_section_area, inside_diameter, moment_of_inertia, section_modulus, mass_per_length, user_defined, TBD.

Section diagnostic codes include SECTION_DIMENSION_MISSING, SECTION_UNIT_MISSING, SECTION_PROVENANCE_MISSING, SECTION_PROTECTED_CONTENT_SUSPECTED, SECTION_CALCULATION_INPUT_INVALID, SECTION_DIMENSION_INCONSISTENT, SECTION_CATALOG_VALUE_NOT_PUBLIC.
ComponentType enum includes bend, elbow, branch, reducer, valve, flange, expansion_joint, rigid, specialty, other, TBD and must equal the model schema Component.component_type enum.
ComponentFieldKind enum covers bend, branch, rigid, and expansion-joint fields including sif_user_value, flexibility_factor_user_value, manufacturer_reference, TBD.
Component diagnostic codes cover field/unit/provenance/protected-content plus bend, branch, rigid-component, and expansion-joint geometry/data-missing and not-public codes.
ComponentFamilyContract requires contract_id, component_types, geometry/rule-modifier/source-metadata field kinds, mechanics_interface, protected_value_policy, review_status.
Component family contract fixtures bind bend/elbow, branch, rigid (valve/flange/reducer/rigid/specialty), and expansion_joint families with protected_value_policy schema_slots_only.

Component fixtures classify incomplete records with public_repository_value_policy slots (no_public_code_specific_values, no_public_proprietary_catalog_values, private_user_supplied_only) and matching SOLVE_BLOCKING diagnostics.
test_constraint_schema.py provides stdlib checks for the constraint entity schema.
Required constraint kinds include connectivity, clearance, no_go_volume, support_zone, route_conflict, slope, drain, vent, access, equipment_interface, missing_required_data.

Required diagnostic classes include CONSTRAINT_MISSING_DATA, CONNECTIVITY_CONFLICT, CLEARANCE_CONFLICT, ROUTE_CONFLICT, SUPPORT_ZONE_CONFLICT, SLOPE_DRAIN_VENT_CONFLICT, PROVENANCE_WARNING, UNIT_WARNING, IP_BOUNDARY_WARNING.
Accepted PKG-02 quantity dimensions are a fixed vocabulary including slope, second_moment_area, section_modulus, mass_per_length, linear/rotational_stiffness and TBD.
Constraint schema pins deliverable_id DEL-13-02, package_id PKG-13, scope_items SOW-067/068, objectives OBJ-014/018.
DataBoundary fixes public_examples_policy invented_or_cleared_data_only, no bundled protected/standards data, explicit unit metadata required, and human review required outside software.
Quantity dimension enum must equal the accepted PKG-02 vocabulary and exclude temperature_difference, area_moment, and stiffness.

Constraint ProfessionalBoundary requires human_review_required True and all software claim flags False; forbidden text (allowable stress table, SIF table, B31J, code compliant, certified/sealed by software) is absent.
test_constraint_validation.py provides focused tests for DEL-13-03 constraint validation.

Constraint validation is deterministic and covers represented diagnostic classes (connectivity, clearance, route, support-zone, slope-drain-vent conflicts, missing data, schema validation, equipment-interface/access availability).

Missing data and unresolved references are explicit blocking findings (CV-CONSTRAINT-MISSING-FIELD, CV-CLEARANCE-TARGETS/PARAMETERS-MISSING, CV-DESIGN-REF-UNRESOLVED, CV-CONSTRAINT-PROVENANCE-MISSING).
Unit metadata is checked without conversion or invented tolerances (CV-UNIT-METADATA-MISSING; messages state it does not convert units or invent tolerances).
Quantity dimensions are checked against the PKG-02 vocabulary; a retired dimension (stiffness) produces a single blocking CV-UNIT-DIMENSION-UNKNOWN while accepted (slope) does not.
Protected or private provenance is preserved as an IP_BOUNDARY_WARNING boundary diagnostic with source references retained.
Constraint validation output text makes no prohibited authority claims (certification, sealing, authentication, code compliant, professional approval, engineering acceptance).
test_coordination_maintenance.py tests tools/coordination/list_deliverable_status.py for deliverable-status discovery.
The status tool discovers local _STATUS.md state and DAG context, mapping deliverable IDs to LocalStatus, DAGNodePresent, and StatusVocabulary (NONSTANDARD_TOLERATED).
The status tool filters statuses without hiding inventory by default (exclude_issued=False).
The live list_deliverable_status.py command runs against DAG-006 with returncode 0 and emits CSV header plus a Rows: summary on stderr.
test_design_authoring_comparison_workspace.py provides focused tests for DEL-07-08 design-authoring and comparison workspace.

The DEL-07-08 workspace is deterministic and preserves review records: workspace_hash sha256, design-knowledge/constraint/state-run panels, comparison tables, overlays, mutation_boundary False, persistence-hash contract DEL-02-05.

Operation review requires an explicit user acceptance record; agent acceptance is held_for_user_acceptance while user acceptance is explicit_user_acceptance_recorded with workspace_application_status not_applied.
Missing inputs and operation mutation signals remain visible (WORKSPACE-DESIGN-KNOWLEDGE-MISSING, WORKSPACE-OPERATION-MUTATION-SIGNAL-BLOCKED) and the workspace never applies operations.
Workspace output boundary language makes no prohibited claims and software_makes_approval_claim is False.
test_design_knowledge_schema.py provides stdlib checks for the design knowledge schema.
Design-knowledge record definitions map to record_kind consts: endpoint, line_data, routing_corridor, zone, equipment_interface, requirement, owner_project_metadata.
Required requirement types are access, slope, drain, vent, clearance, support, owner_project_metadata.
Design knowledge schema pins deliverable_id DEL-13-01, package_id PKG-13, scope_item SOW-067, objective OBJ-014.
Each design-knowledge record requires id, record_kind, name, source_notes, assumptions, provenance with a constant record_kind.
PrivacyClassification enum includes public_metadata, invented_public_example, private_project_data, owner_project_metadata_private, protected_suspected, redacted.
Design-knowledge Quantity dimension enum equals the accepted PKG-02 vocabulary and excludes temperature_difference, area_moment, stiffness.
test_evidence_sweep.py provides focused tests for the DEC-025 five-surface evidence sweep entrypoint.
The DEC-025 evidence sweep plan is five surfaces in order: cargo_crate_sweep, python_pytest, desktop_vitest, desktop_playwright_e2e, desktop_production_build.
The WASM engine build precedes vitest: desktop_vitest commands are 'npm run build:wasm:desktop' then 'npm run test:desktop'.
The sweep plan uses local commands only (python executable or npm).
The cargo surface reuses the release-readiness cargo profile via check_release_readiness.py --profile cargo --execute.
The sweep summary (artifact openpipestress.evidence_sweep_summary, schema_version 2, decision_basis DEC-025) binds a 40-char commit hash and passes when all surfaces pass.
parse_porcelain_status keeps the full path for an unstaged first record and handles rename, untracked, and staged records (sorted).
collect_git_state does not strip the leading space from dirty paths (regression: stripped ` M <path>` cut the first path char).
The sweep fails fast: a failing surface marks itself fail and later surfaces not_run with empty commands.
A failing command stops its surface (failing build:wasm:desktop fails desktop_vitest before test:desktop).
The summary filename binds commit and dirty state (SWEEP_<utc>_<commit12>-dirty.json).
collect_git_state records capture failure explicitly: a failed git status sets status_capture_failed True, working_tree_dirty None, and git_state_unverified True (never reads as clean).
The summary filename marks unverified git state (-gitunverified.json).
main --dry-run prints the plan without executing the sweep; --execute writes one SWEEP_*.json summary and returns the failure exit code.
test_export_adapter_sdk.py provides focused tests for DEL-17-09 export adapter SDK admission packages.
The export adapter SDK builder is deterministic with deliverable_id DEL-17-09, package_status export_adapter_sdk_foundation, runtime_grant_policy denied_by_default, and required manifest members.
The target registry records candidate_non_gating admission with tbd target_version_basis, denied-by-default grants, and a fixed validation-checklist category set.

Runtime grants (filesystem, network, process, private_data, storage, rule_pack, solver, report_control) are all requested False and denied_by_default; professional boundary creates no loader/endpoint/target/release/reliance claim.

Negative cases block requested runtime grants, missing source basis, and missing stable-id/loss-report policies (EASDK-RUNTIME-GRANT-REQUESTED, EASDK-SOURCE-BASIS-MISSING, EASDK-TARGET-STABLE-ID/LOSS-REPORT-POLICY-MISSING).
Contract and admitted-target source basis are guarded (EASDK-CONTRACT-SOURCE-BASIS-INCOMPLETE, EASDK-ADMITTED-TARGET-SOURCE-BASIS-INSUFFICIENT).
Export adapter SDK output makes no prohibited professional or target-claim language (no target support, release readiness, code compliance, professional acceptance, compatible-with).
test_external_prover_boundary_metadata.py provides focused tests for DEL-15-04 external-prover boundary metadata.

External-prover metadata is deterministic and preserves boundary links (deliverable_id DEL-15-04, contract status non_authoritative_workflow_metadata, handoff/target-mapping/export/model-state refs, human_review_required True).
Proposed authority and lifecycle claims are blocking diagnostics (EPM-AUTHORITY-CLAIM-REJECTED, EPM-PROHIBITED-AUTHORITY-TERM) and the claim disposition is rejected_boundary_claim.
An embedded attachment payload is blocked (EPM-ATTACHMENT-PAYLOAD-EMBEDDED).
Boundary flags cannot be flipped to software authority (EPM-SOFTWARE-AUTHORITY-FLAG-BLOCKED, EPM-EXTERNAL-EXECUTION-BLOCKED).
Authority wording in notes and tags is a blocking diagnostic (EPM-PROHIBITED-AUTHORITY-TERM affecting both tags and notes).
External-prover metadata output makes no prohibited claims; external_tool_invoked, commercial_result_payload_ingested, and software_creates_professional_reliance_record are all False.
test_gui_editors_contract.py provides focused tests for DEL-07-03 GUI editor contracts.
The GUI editor contract (DEL-07-03) uses references-and-checksums-only private payload policy, no persistent project mutation, canonical dimensions, unit contract DEL-02-02, and no approval claim.
A rule-pack reference editor missing a checksum and an unresolved field value emit RULE_PACK_CHECKSUM_MISSING and EDITOR_FIELD_VALUE_UNRESOLVED diagnostics.
An editor field missing unit metadata emits EDITOR_UNIT_METADATA_MISSING and sets validation_state blocked_by_contract_metadata.
